## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!spin` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "title": "Weekend giveaway",
  "prizes": [
    "Free coffee",
    "10% off",
    "Try again",
    "Free pastry",
    "20% off",
    "Try again"
  ]
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --grape: #b44cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --night: #2a1d5e; --night-2: #33256f; --muted: #c9bff0; --size: min(78vw, 270px); }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, rgba(180, 76, 255, .45), transparent 62%), repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 42%, var(--night) 0 9deg, var(--night-2) 9deg 18deg); color: var(--cream); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 14px; text-align: center; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; max-width: 100%; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  #wheel { display: block; width: var(--size); height: var(--size); flex: none; }
  #result { min-height: 24px; max-width: 100%; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; }
  #result b { color: var(--yellow); font-weight: 800; }
  #result.won { animation: pop .45s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.8, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes pop { 40% { transform: scale(1.18); } }
  #spin { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #c98f00; font: 800 17px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .1s ease; }
  #spin:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c98f00; }
  #spin:disabled { background: #6b5b9a; color: var(--cream); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #3f3270; cursor: default; }
  .note { max-width: 300px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
  .confetti { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #result.won { animation: none; } #spin { transition: none; } }
</style>
<h1 id="title">Prize wheel</h1>
<canvas id="wheel" role="img" aria-label="Prize wheel"></canvas>
<div id="result" aria-live="polite">Tap Spin to pick a prize</div>
<button id="spin" type="button">Spin</button>
<div class="note">Random pick: every slice has the same chance. The result stays on this phone.</div>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = { title: 'Prize wheel', ready: 'Tap Spin to pick a prize', spinning: 'Spinning…', result: 'You got: ', spin: 'Spin', again: 'Spin again' };
  var EXAMPLE = ['Prize A', 'Prize B', 'Try again', 'Prize C'];
  // Deep violet and grape carry white labels; the lighter slices carry ink labels.
  var SLICES = [['#ff4f8b', '#1d1442'], ['#ff8a3d', '#1d1442'], ['#ffc93c', '#1d1442'], ['#9be15d', '#1d1442'], ['#2ed8a7', '#1d1442'], ['#38b6ff', '#1d1442'], ['#6a45ff', '#ffffff'], ['#9a2ee6', '#ffffff']];
  var INK = '#1d1442', CREAM = '#fff8ec', RIM = '#1d1442', BULBS = ['#ffc93c', '#fff8ec'], POINTER = '#ff4f8b';
  var TAU = Math.PI * 2, MAX_SLICES = 12;

  function mod(a, n) { return ((a % n) + n) % n; }

  function sliceAt(rotation, count) {
    return Math.floor(mod(-rotation, TAU) / (TAU / count)) % count;
  }

  // Lands inside the chosen slice, away from its edges, after 4-5 full turns.
  function targetFor(current, index, count, rand) {
    var offset = (index + 0.15 + 0.7 * rand()) * (TAU / count);
    var turns = 4 + Math.floor(rand() * 2);
    return current + turns * TAU + mod(-offset - current, TAU);
  }

  // Keeps the last slice from matching the first when the palette wraps.
  function styleFor(i, count) {
    var k = i % SLICES.length;
    if (count > 1 && i === count - 1 && k === 0) k = 6;
    return SLICES[k];
  }

  var prizes = DATA && DATA.prizes && DATA.prizes.length >= 2 ? DATA.prizes.slice(0, MAX_SLICES).map(String) : EXAMPLE;
  var title = DATA && DATA.title ? String(DATA.title) : TEXT.title;
  var canvas = document.getElementById('wheel');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var resultEl = document.getElementById('result');
  var spinBtn = document.getElementById('spin');
  var rotation = -Math.PI / prizes.length, winner = -1, spinning = false, kick = 0, lastSlice = -1;

  document.getElementById('title').textContent = title;
  canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', title + ' with ' + prizes.length + ' slices: ' + prizes.join(', '));

  function fit(text, max) {
    if (ctx.measureText(text).width <= max) return text;
    while (text.length > 1 && ctx.measureText(text + '…').width > max) text = text.slice(0, -1);
    return text + '…';
  }

  function slice(cx, cy, radius, start, seg) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, start, start + seg);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw() {
    var px = canvas.clientWidth, ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var side = Math.round(px * ratio);
    if (canvas.width !== side || canvas.height !== side) { canvas.width = side; canvas.height = side; }
    ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, px, px);
    var n = prizes.length, seg = TAU / n, cx = px / 2, cy = px / 2 + 3, rim = px / 2 - 5, r = rim - 10;
    var fontSize = n > 8 || px < 250 ? 12 : 13;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, rim, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = RIM;
    ctx.fill();
    var phase = spinning ? Math.floor(Date.now() / 140) % 2 : 0;
    for (var b = 0; b < 16; b++) {
      var ba = b / 16 * TAU;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx + Math.cos(ba) * (rim - 5), cy + Math.sin(ba) * (rim - 5), 2.6, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = BULBS[(b + phase) % 2];
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.font = '700 ' + fontSize + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    for (var pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var won = i === winner;
        if ((pass === 1) !== won) continue;
        var start = -Math.PI / 2 + rotation + i * seg, mid = start + seg / 2, style = styleFor(i, n);
        // The winning slice is drawn last and nudged outward so it reads without color.
        var ox = won ? Math.cos(mid) * 5 : 0, oy = won ? Math.sin(mid) * 5 : 0;
        slice(cx + ox, cy + oy, r, start, seg);
        ctx.fillStyle = style[0];
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = won ? CREAM : RIM;
        ctx.lineWidth = won ? 4 : 2;
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(cx + ox, cy + oy);
        var flip = Math.cos(mid) < 0;
        // Left-half labels are turned around so no text reads upside down.
        ctx.rotate(flip ? mid + Math.PI : mid);
        ctx.textAlign = flip ? 'left' : 'right';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillStyle = style[1];
        ctx.fillText(fit((won ? '★ ' : '') + prizes[i], r - 34), flip ? 13 - r : r - 13, 0);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 19, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = CREAM;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = RIM;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 7, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = POINTER;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, 4);
    ctx.rotate(kick * 0.35);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-13, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(13, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 23);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = POINTER;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = CREAM;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function confetti() {
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    var cv = document.createElement('canvas'), w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight, r = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var g = cv.getContext('2d'), bits = [], t0 = 0;
    cv.className = 'confetti';
    cv.width = w * r;
    cv.height = h * r;
    document.body.appendChild(cv);
    for (var i = 0; i < 80; i++) bits.push({ x: w / 2, y: h * 0.4, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 11, vy: -3 - Math.random() * 9, s: 6 + Math.random() * 5, a: Math.random() * 6, c: SLICES[i % SLICES.length][0] });
    function frame(now) {
      if (!t0) t0 = now;
      var t = now - t0;
      g.setTransform(r, 0, 0, r, 0, 0);
      g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      g.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - t / 1500);
      bits.forEach(function (b) {
        b.vy += 0.3; b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy; b.a += 0.2;
        g.save(); g.translate(b.x, b.y); g.rotate(b.a); g.fillStyle = b.c; g.fillRect(-b.s / 2, -b.s / 4, b.s, b.s / 2); g.restore();
      });
      if (t < 1500) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else cv.remove();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function spin() {
    if (spinning) return;
    spinning = true;
    winner = -1;
    spinBtn.disabled = true;
    resultEl.className = '';
    resultEl.textContent = TEXT.spinning;
    var pick = Math.floor(Math.random() * prizes.length);
    var from = rotation, to = targetFor(rotation, pick, prizes.length, Math.random);
    var calm = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    var duration = calm ? 1200 : 3000 + Math.random() * 2000, begin = 0;
    function frame(now) {
      if (!begin) begin = now;
      var t = Math.min(1, (now - begin) / duration);
      rotation = from + (to - from) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3));
      var at = sliceAt(rotation, prizes.length);
      if (at !== lastSlice && !calm) kick = 1;
      lastSlice = at;
      kick *= 0.8;
      if (t < 1) { draw(); requestAnimationFrame(frame); return; }
      rotation = mod(to, TAU);
      winner = sliceAt(rotation, prizes.length);
      spinning = false;
      kick = 0;
      spinBtn.disabled = false;
      spinBtn.textContent = TEXT.again;
      resultEl.textContent = TEXT.result;
      var b = document.createElement('b');
      b.textContent = prizes[winner];
      resultEl.appendChild(b);
      resultEl.className = 'won';
      draw();
      if (prizes[winner].toLowerCase().indexOf('try again') === -1) confetti();
    }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  spinBtn.addEventListener('click', spin);
  window.addEventListener('resize', draw);
  resultEl.textContent = TEXT.ready;
  draw();
</script>
`

client.command('spin', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Spin wheel",
    height: 450,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The prize wheel opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

| | |

| Size | 10.1 KB |
| Input | Tap |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
